figurative_meaning_bn: স্বামীর উপর স্ত্রীর প্রভাব/প্রভুত্ব; স্ত্রীর একান্ত অনুগত
figurative_meaning_en: The wife's influence or dominance over the husband; extremely devoted to the wife
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার স্বামী সম্পূর্ণ অঞ্চলপ্রভাবে বেঁধে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is completely under his wife's pallu influence.
In this household, the wife's influence is very strong.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali attire (sari's pallu) symbolizing wifely control; synonymous with আঁচলধরা.
